Information disclosed in accordance with Listing Rule 11.2.6 (former LR 15.4)

In accordance with Listing Rule 11.2.6 (former LR 15.4) the Company confirms that, as at 30th September 2026, it had a portfolio investment in 3i Group plc, a company which does not itself have an investment policy that limits its investments in other listed closed-ended investment funds to no more than 15% of its total assets.
